Question: I m the follower of Hanafi Madhab. Can i read dua during ruku(I mean to say after subhana rabial azeem 3 times can i say "subuhun - qudoosun- rabul malaa-ika ti-varrooh") same in sajda (Subhana rabial aala and then "subuhun - qudoosun- rabul malaa-ika ti-varrooh" ? and same in total salah like (after ruku rabana lakl hamd- then " hamdan kaseeran tayiban mubarakan fi"? Answer ID: 26527 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1511/1511/M=1431) These azkar are related to nawafil, i.e. one can read them in nawafil. و ما ورد حمل على النفل منفردا ً كما مر (در مختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
